title: Commission-Free Brokers: Are You Trading Or Being Traded?
text:
----------------------------------------
Earns some revenue from directing orders to market makers in exchange for payments. Primarily earns through commissions, spreads, or fees directly from clients. Often offers zero or lower commission trades. Typically charges commissions or fees per trade, but can also offer zero commissions. Orders are routed to market makers or third parties who pay for the order flow. Orders are executed through a variety of market venues. Higher, due to financial incentives from market makers. May have less transparency in how orders are routed and executed. Generally more transparent about order execution and routing. Subject to scrutiny and bans in some regions (e.g., EU, UK).
